label: scenario-probe
_why: Verifies the unverified half of the scenario-calibration instrument BEFORE spending the measurement runs: per-building enumeration (urban-centre levels + employment), pop standard-of-living by stratum, and which of the three early-read hooks (day 0 / day 7 / a 1836.1.1 monthly pulse) actually fires. Two arms because the control must instrument identically; both stop at 1836.4.1.
